title: MEIKO — Narrator Of Happiness〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I wonder what Emu's doing right now...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for letting me borrow that Miku costume, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Emu...
You eyes look redder than before.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I was really moved by your guys' show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The ending surprised me a little, but it also made me really happy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for coming up with that for us!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Based on the way she smiled, she certainly seemed genuinely happy...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Does this mean Emu's really going to stay behind at Phoenix Wonderland and...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's like something's been bothering you since our show ended.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes...
I can't help but worry about her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is Emu really not going to join Tsukasa and the others...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Emu loves the Wonder Stage and Phoenix Wonderland very much since they're essentially mementos of her grandfather...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that she'll want to keep protecting them even if it means having to feel sad at times.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I understand what she's feeling right now. And I wanna support her decision since she's so important to us...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You gotta hear this...!
I... I...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, what did we say?! Don't run ahead without us!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What's going on?
Your eyes are all...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We... We get to keep doing shows together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez, you're sobbing so much that we can't hear what you're trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I can't say that I blame any of you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, can you tell us what happened?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. Emu's brothers just came by and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, they told Emu to venture out into the world to see and experience as many new things as she can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I'm really sorry for making you worry so much, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, don't mind me♪
All's well that ends well, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Would you like to borrow my handkerchief, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This is so wonderful, Rui!
I'm really glad you didn't give up until the end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, I don't think I accomplished anything. Emu had her mind made up...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Her brothers are the ones who ultimately made this all possible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, they may've been the ones who carried her over the line. However...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rui, I believe you explaining exactly how you feel played a crucial role in making that moment happen!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've experienced this a number of times before, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's proof of how one's most honest feelings have the ability to move people's hearts!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But if what you say is right, MEIKO, I guess it's good to be selfish sometimes...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(I've seen just how much Rui's had on his mind...
And how carefully he's always thought about what to do next.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We really couldn't have asked for a happier ending!
